sentences.en: Am I right in assuming that my commentaries irritate you?
sentences.zh: 我猜我这解说让你不高兴了？

sentences.en: People sometimes narrate their actions to themselves as a running commentary.
sentences.zh: 人们有时会一边做动作一边自言自语进行解说。

sentences.en: The narrative provided some eye-opening social commentary on the state of the country.
sentences.zh: 这个叙述提供了一些关于国家现状的令人耳目一新的社会评论。

senses.zh: 解说词,评论，评注,注释，注解,个人生平传记
